title: Night visitors in the twins' childhood home

tellings.quote: We used to have these things happen at night in our house where we'd be sleeping in bed. We both shared the same room and we'd wake up in the night and there'd be something pulling the covers off our beds.

plain: In the 1950s, in their childhood home near Allentown, Pennsylvania, twin brothers say they would wake at night to find "something pulling the covers off our beds." Jim Weiner, who has spoken publicly about alien abduction experiences with his twin Jack Weiner, tells it as something the two of them lived through in their shared bedroom. He tells it because it suggests their strange encounters began long before adulthood.
